shots.description: A five-star Palmline Mariner chase with the police helicopter overhead, nitro flame, wanted HUD, mission marker, minimap and Sol Wave DJ report.
Palmetto Customs shop panel showing weapon purchases and garage upgrades over Solmara's road grid, with cash, health, radio and mission HUD.
Marco's flyable helicopter above Solmara in Autumn, with the coastal grid, rooftops, mission marker and aerial HUD.
Winter night drive with falling snow, street lighting, headlamps, pursuit heat, radio DJ report, minimap and mission HUD.
